description: Domain lookup: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, CAA via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, DNSSEC AD flag) plus registration data from the registry's RDAP server (IANA bootstrap): registrar + IANA id, created / updated / expiry dates, age in days, days to expiry, EPP status, nameservers, DNSSEC delegation, registrar abuse contact. No registrant personal data. Charged only when DNS answered (NOERROR) or the registry RDAP returned the registration. TLDs without RDAP (e.g. .de, .io) still succeed with DNS records and rdap_available:false. NXDOMAIN with no registration (404 DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND), upstream failure (502) and bad input (400) are not charged. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. github.com (URLs, emails and Unicode names are normalized)

name: domain_lookup
